dedupe_keys.name: description of the probabilistic wind atlas methodology

description: Hahmann, Andrea N. and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented comparison uses nine WRF configurations spanning the stated boundary-layer, reinitialisation and land-surface choices, together with analog-ensemble methods for short-to-long-term resource estimates. Ten South African masts provide evaluation evidence. Nine selected combinations are not described as a complete factorial design. The source identifies the risk of overconfidence from correlated ensemble members. This supports wind-resource uncertainty assessment under the tested sites and modelling choices; downloadable executable code is not established. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
